text.description_html:
RK International CK-309, Black Porcelain Knob with Matching Base

The Black Porcelain Flat Cabinet Knob is available with either a polished brass base or a polished chrome base; but no matter what finish you choose, this knob has a retro flair that is breath-taking. The black porcelain is sleek and clean looking with a bold character and depth that keeps it glamourous. Luxe in appearance, it is perfect for any application where you would use a small knob such as on dresser drawers or as closet door pulls.

Also Available Matching: White Porcelain Flat Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-309 Black Porcelain Knob:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: Black
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
